# Jessibuca

> Pure H5 live-stream player for the browser (wasm / MSE / WebCodecs).

## Docs for agents

- [Open-source API spec (markdown, use this to write code)](/jessibuca-api.md): constructor, options, methods, events, errors, recipes
- [Open-source API HTML](/api.html): same API with longer explanations
- [TypeScript types](/jessibuca.d.ts): `Jessibuca` / `Jessibuca.Config`
- [User guide](/document.html): FAQ, deployment, decoder path, codec notes
- [Open-source demo](/player.html)

## Optional Pro product

Pro has a separate constructor (`JessibucaPro`) and decoder. Do not mix Pro APIs into open-source examples.

- [Pro player demo](/player-pro.html)
- [Pro overview](/pro.html)
